top_signals.title: Chief Future Officer: Mandy Fields, e.l.f. Beauty
top_signals.summary: Chief Financial Officers now play a critical role in shaping corporate strategy and positioning organizations to meet future challenges. This episode profiles e.l.f. Beauty CFO Mandy Fields, who has helped lead the cosmetics company to 30 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. Bolstered by the purchase of Hailey Bieber's Rhode brand, e.l.f. now sees skincare as a path to even stronger long-term success. (Source: Bloomberg)
